newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman ups chemical stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman ups chemical stocks.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs raised its rating on four chemical stocks, a source at the brokerage said.
-- Goldman raised Eastman Chemical Co to market outperform from market perform;
-- Millennium Chemicals Inc to market outperform from outperform;
-- ARCO Chemical Co to market outperform from market perform;
-- Lyondell Petrochemical Co to market perform from underperform.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for comment.
-- Eastman Chemical was up 7/8 at 56-1/4, Millenium was up 1/4 at 20-3/4, ARCO was unchanged at 49 and Lyondell was up 1/8 at 21.
